For a $100 micro-grant where certainty of positive impact matters, bednets offer a robust, high-confidence return. The cost-effectiveness estimates (~$3,000–$5,000 per DALY averted or life saved) are grounded in strong empirical data, making this the more defensible allocation when the decision must be made now with no further information.
